thread:
maya_cs: Hey @support, customer AcmeX is seeing a burst of 599s from the /v1/generate endpoint since ~08:15 PST. ~10% of calls are failing with '599 upstream read' and their SDK is retrying into a loop. sample trace id: tx-9a8b7f3d

sarah_support: thanks — can you paste their minimal repro + region + sdk version?

maya_cs: region: us-west2. sdk: 1.3.0. They sent this curl to test:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-alpha-13b","input":"hello"}'
```

jenna_sdk: can you also paste their Node snippet and whether they rely on default retries?

maya_cs: Node snippet (default client, no special backoff):

```js
const R = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new R.Client({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-alpha-13b', input: 'hello' });
```

sarah_support: notes — customer runs many short-lived worker processes on Heroku dynos that spin up/tear down fairly rapidly. they suspect heavy fanout.

ali_oncall: digging into proxy logs for us-west2 — seeing large spike of TLS session re-negotiations and 'upstream connection reset' between 08:12 and 08:20. many requests show no keep-alive reuse. hypothesis: connection churn + auth refresh fanout -> proxy thread exhaustion -> 599s.

jenna_sdk: SDK v1.3.0 doesn't throttle token refresh across processes. if each worker fetches tokens concurrently you'll flood auth + upstream. recommend client-side connection pooling or upgrade to the patched SDK.

infra-bot: traces correlated: ~47% of 599s have an auth refresh call within 200ms prior to the failed generate call. auth service experienced elevated p95 during the window.

ali_oncall: short mitigation: bump proxy upstream timeout and restart proxy pool in us-west2 to clear stuck connections. medium-term: add token-refresh de-duplication and auth rate-limits.

deploy-bot: initiated rolling restart of proxy pods in us-west2 (3 pods) — started 08:28 PST, expected ~2m to finish.

sarah_support: drafting customer message: apology, cause explanation (high auth/token fanout + connection churn), actions we took (proxy restart + temporary timeout bump), and recommended customer mitigations (SDK keepalive/pooling or reduce process churn). asking for last 2 request-ids to verify.

maya_cs: customer asked for ETA on fix — told them we'll monitor 30m and proposed SDK patch (v1.3.2) that includes token refresh throttling.

jenna_sdk: immediate SDK workaround: enable connectionPooling: true and set maxSockets: 100 in client options, or migrate to a long-lived client process to reuse sockets. v1.3.2 will ship backoff+singleflight for token refresh.

maya_cs: customer applied the connectionPooling change and reduced worker restart cadence. they reported error rate dropped dramatically within 5m.

sarah_support: after the proxy restart and customer mitigation, error rate in us-west2 dropped from ~9% to ~0.6% within 10 minutes. keeping monitoring dashboards pinned. :eyes: 

maya_cs: final update 09:02 PST — customer confirms resolution after applying SDK patch and reducing parallel token refresh. they will watch for 24h no regressions before we close. thanks team. :thumbsup:

jenna_sdk: follow-up: we'll cut a patch release (v1.3.2) with token refresh singleflight and connection pooling defaults. I'll open PR and link here.

ali_oncall: will file a post-incident note with timeline and traceback snippets.

sarah_support: I'll send the official postmortem and the customer-facing summary once PR and post-incident note are in.
